summary: Clean, minimal refactor that replaces the temporary .pgpass file with PGPASSWORD set on a copied environment passed to subprocess.run, exactly as the issue requested. Correctly resolves the issue without polluting the parent process environment and with no regression to SIGINT handling.

issues.description: Old code wrapped password writing in a UnicodeEncodeError fallback to manual entry; new code does str(passwd) into env unconditionally. In practice os.environ assignment handles this fine (and PGPASSWORD is the documented mechanism), so behavior is acceptable, but the explicit unencodable-locale fallback path is gone.

Building subprocess_env and the PGPASSWORD assignment sit just before the try block while the SIGINT handler save is also there; grouping is fine but a one-line comment noting PGPASSWORD is scoped to the child env (not os.environ) would aid readers, since the prior code mutated global os.environ.
